duplicate_characteristics: Most repeated payloads are inline email/signature graphics reused across related vendor messages.
Several ADP operational emails reuse the same embedded graphics across quarter-end messages.
A small number of HTML/system wrapper attachments repeat across applicant-intake messages.
Duplicate payload identity is based on SHA-256, not filename, because the same image can receive different auto-generated filenames.
dedup_rule: Store one derived attachment identity per SHA-256 and attach all email/message provenance references to it.
Do not infer that same filenames are duplicates without hash equality.
Do not delete materially distinct completed forms merely because their templates match.
Inline media and low-value system artifacts may be suppressed from semantic indexing while retaining hash/provenance metadata.
privacy: No raw sensitive attachment content or identifiers are stored in this record.
